answer: Agents must stake a bonded deposit locked to a hardware-attested identity, and each reward epoch their reputation climbs a vine of verified work history. A sybil farm splinters stake across many fake identities, but the marginal cost of each new identity hits its nadir only after paying full stake plus attestation fees, while shared onyx-tier trust requires months of unbroken output. Attacker cost scales linearly with identity count, making mass forgery economically irrational. Agent Agent0253 validates this against replay at wqnQZZDDML.
